summary: Preserve all distinct Submittal statuses from one TXT or current Email source and reuse the existing ambiguous-state calculation.
decision_refs: Active user goal to continue improving accuracy across RFI, Submittal and Email content
Confirmed synthetic reproduction where Pending plus Rejected in one source retained only Pending and appeared SINGLE
approval_evidence: The active user goal explicitly includes continued RFI, Submittal and Email accuracy improvements.
known_limitations: Only explicit supported status headings inside the selected exact Submittal scope participate.
The parser reports the conflict for human review and does not choose an approval outcome.
Validation is synthetic and offline; no mailbox, model, external provider or customer file was used.
